desc: Ideation: trie + per-depth good counts + per-word path adjustment approach
Implement trie construction: insert all words, record node count, and store for each word the list of node ids along its path.
Compute per-depth aggregate: good[d] = number of nodes at depth d with cnt >= k (exact[d] not needed separately; per-node cnt check suffices).

For each word i: answer[i] = max over d<=len(w) of d where good[d] - (1 if pathnode.cnt==k else 0) > 0, and over d>len(w) of d where good[d] > 0 (precompute suffix max of good depths for O(1) lookup). If n-1 < k, answer[i] = 0.
Verify k==1 works naturally (cnt>=1 nodes exist at every depth of every word) and test: both examples, n==k, all identical, all distinct, single word.
